reference_sql:
WITH product_rev AS (  -- one row per product with 2025 sales
  SELECT category_name, product_id, SUM(net_revenue_eur) AS revenue
  FROM sales
  WHERE order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND order_date < DATE '2026-01-01'
  GROUP BY category_name, product_id
),
ranked AS (  -- one row per product with 2025 sales
  SELECT category_name, product_id, revenue,
         RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY category_name ORDER BY revenue DESC) AS revenue_rank
  FROM product_rev
)
SELECT category_name, product_id, revenue, revenue_rank
FROM ranked
WHERE revenue_rank <= 2
alternatives:
WITH product_rev AS (  -- one row per product with 2025 sales
  SELECT category_name, product_id, SUM(net_revenue_eur) AS revenue
  FROM sales
  WHERE order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND order_date < DATE '2026-01-01'
  GROUP BY category_name, product_id
)
SELECT pr.category_name, pr.product_id, pr.revenue,
       1 + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM product_rev pr2 WHERE pr2.category_name = pr.category_name AND pr2.revenue > pr.revenue) AS revenue_rank
FROM product_rev pr
WHERE (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM product_rev pr2 WHERE pr2.category_name = pr.category_name AND pr2.revenue > pr.revenue) < 2

SELECT t.category_name, t.product_id, t.revenue, t.revenue_rank
FROM (
  -- one row per product with 2025 sales
  SELECT category_name, product_id, SUM(net_revenue_eur) AS revenue,
         RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY category_name ORDER BY SUM(net_revenue_eur) DESC) AS revenue_rank
  FROM sales
  WHERE order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND order_date < DATE '2026-01-01'
  GROUP BY category_name, product_id
) AS t
WHERE t.revenue_rank <= 2
